units.source_text: 这一群人也是徒步而来的。

en.t: This group of people had also come on foot.

units.source_text: 内有上流妇女二人，男女仆从甚多，马四五匹。

en.t: Among them were two women of high rank, many male and female servants, and four or five horses.

units.source_text: 他们悄悄地进来，并不嚣张。

en.t: They came in quietly and did not behave arrogantly.

units.source_text: 但其中也有几个相貌堂堂的男子。

en.t: But among them were also several fine-looking men.

units.source_text: 法师原定留这班人泊宿，

en.t: The priest had originally planned to let this party stay for the night,

units.source_text: 为了被玉鬘等占先，不免懊恼，搔着头皮。

en.t: but because Tamakazura and her companions had taken the place first, he could not help feeling vexed and scratched his head.
Tamakazura and the others felt awkward.

units.source_text: 另找宿处呢，太不成样，而且麻烦。

en.t: Looking for another lodging would have been unseemly and troublesome.

units.source_text: 于是一部分人退入里面房间，

en.t: So some of them withdrew into the inner rooms,

units.source_text: 一部分人躲在外面房间，

en.t: some hid in the outer rooms,
and the rest were moved aside.

units.source_text: 玉鬘所居之处，用帐幕隔开。

en.t: The place where Tamakazura stayed was screened off with curtains.

units.source_text: 新来之客也不是傲慢之人，态度非常谦恭。

en.t: The newly arrived guests were not arrogant people either, and their manner was very humble and courteous.
The two sides showed consideration for each other.
